Eli H: Quick ping - I'm refreshing the HelloKit quickstart to use SDK v2, rename REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_KEY, and add a short CI smoke test that boots the sample. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512. Need snippet review and someone to double-check the CI change.

Tara F: Paste the node/python snippets here? I'll scan for best practices and async error handling.

Eli H: Node: ```js
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
try {
  const r = await client.generate({ model: 'rw-lite-3b', input: 'Hello HelloKit' })
  console.log(r.text)
} catch (e) {
  console.error(e)
}
```
Python: ```py
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
resp = client.generate(model='rw-lite-3b', input='Hello HelloKit')
print(resp['text'])
```
